name: [UPD] Anime Tower
desc:
💥 ANIME TROLL TOWER 💥
⚔️ Climb the Anime Tower and unleash chaos with your favorite anime powers!
🏃‍♂️ Race to the top, unlock legendary anime characters, and use their trolling abilities to blast, push, trap, or teleport other players!
🔓 UNLOCK CHARACTERS
🥇 Beat Anime Tower to unlock iconic anime-inspired fighters, each with their own unique troll abilities!
🌟 Can you master them all and make it to the top without getting flung off?

✨ If you’re having fun, make sure to LIKE 👍, FAVORITE ⭐, and SHARE the game with your friends!
🎉 Join our group for special characters! https://www.roblox.com/communities/32523075
